question: A man receives ₹4,900 per month as salary. He saves 17% of his salary every month. His expenditure per month is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Salary** is always 100%.

**Savings** = 17%

**Expenditure** = 100% − 17% = 83%

**Expenditure** = 4900 × 0.83 = 4067

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,067.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Monthly Salary** = ₹4,900

**Savings Percentage** = 17%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f066677aa1409f3c44d1f1f8c32d19328c00345d4bb8e6f7e9f1b9d2a03ae3bf.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Monthly Savings** = 17% of ₹4,900

⇒ **Monthly Savings** = (17 ÷ 100) × 4900 = 17 × 49 = ₹833

⇒ **Monthly Expenditure** = **Total Salary** − **Monthly Savings**

⇒ **Monthly Expenditure** = 4900 − 833

⇒ **Monthly Expenditure** = ₹4,067

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,067.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income, Expenditure and Savings Relationship

The fundamental relation is **Income = Expenditure + Savings**. Any change in one component affects the others accordingly.

Percentage Change

If **Income** increases by x% and **Expenditure** increases by y%, the new values can be calculated using **Base × (100 + Change)/100**.

Effective Savings Ratio

Savings Ratio = (**Savings** ÷ **Income**) × 100. It represents the portion of total earning kept aside for future use.
